title: Stack Scout // Updates
summary: Public-safe activity stream seeded from official or first-party sources.

items.title: Andrew Curran repeats rumors of an RSA-breaking advance at OpenAI and Anthropic
items.summary: Curran says the unconfirmed rumors concern both AI labs and have circulated for about ten days.

items.title: @ladyxtel claims OpenHuman agents used a Riemann Hypothesis proof to derive 17 results
items.summary: @ladyxtel says six named conjectures were among 17 results, with Lean checking every proof.

items.title: Schumer urges bipartisan bills to curb AI-chip exports to China
items.summary: Rania Khalek challenges lawmakers’ national-security focus, arguing healthcare should take priority over China chip-sales concerns.

items.title: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to lift blockade on AI agent Muse
items.summary: Amazon and Meta are discussing a potential deal that would end a two-month-long blockade of Muse.

items.title: The questions Jensen Huang and Nvidia will still have to answer about Megaspeed
items.summary: Huang still faces questions from Congress and his own board about his romantic relationship with an alleged chip smuggler.

items.title: Mantic says its AI forecaster roughly matches Fable 5.2 (medium) at one-fifteenth the cost per forecast
items.summary: The team’s 100,000-forecast S&P 500 demo is a giant what-if exercise, not a sneak peek at 2027.

items.title: RumiFold gives Qwen a protein-folding job before letting it talk
items.summary: Northeastern researchers say their adapted chat model predicts protein backbones internally, improving function predictions but weakening general language performance.

items.title: Google Research repo says Cogentic generated six new math papers
items.summary: The GitHub commit promises Lean 4 formalizations of all six proofs in a later companion submission.

items.title: Avalon-M1 gives AI agents a CEO and a deadline
items.summary: Researchers report similar average scores at roughly one-third the derived latency of token-matched solo execution, with mixed oversight results.

items.title: Calling Slotbound ‘vibe-coded’ skips the work, Gergely Orosz argues
items.summary: Orosz challenged a post touting Slotbound’s claimed $1.33 million week, arguing that AI assistance doesn’t erase its creator’s work.

items.summary: An Indic Voice Agent with CUGA

items.title: Yale’s Sonnenfeld: Nvidia is a ‘detriment’ to US industrial might — not a champion
items.summary: Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld warns that what the market cheered Monday, Jensen Huang's White House–backed return as Nvidia's CEO and board member, could prove a giant mistake, exposing the directors to "historic" personal liability from a growing pile of lawsuits and raising the question of whether the country is celebrating a company that has helped put…

items.title: Jensen Huang still thinks a succession plan creates unnecessary hierarchy
items.summary: It's a remarkable stance for a company that spent the last two weeks finding out what happens without its founder.

items.title: In all-hands meeting, Jensen Huang thanks White House and says he’s in therapy
items.summary: The Nvidia founder apologized to his staff on Tuesday and said he was grateful for a second chance to lead the company.

items.title: Even the best AI agents struggle with everyday life
items.summary: As millions embrace personal AI assistants, a new benchmark reveals that even the most advanced AI models struggle to complete everyday tasks reliably and safely without introducing potential new problems.

items.title: Make opened its CLI to all users
items.summary: Make's 2026 release notes show the Make CLI becoming available to all users, continuing the platform's expansion beyond the browser UI.

items.title: GitHub MCP Server reached 1.0.0
items.summary: The official GitHub MCP server hit 1.0.0 with granular issue field tooling and broader MCP Apps support behind feature flags.

items.title: GitHub CLI 2.90.0 introduced `gh skill` in public preview
items.summary: The latest GitHub CLI release adds search, install, preview, update, and publish flows for portable agent skills.

items.title: Hugging Face added Kernels to the Hub
items.summary: The Hub changelog added Kernels as a new way to browse precompiled, hardware-specific kernels and also continues to push agent traces into the product story.

items.title: Strudel Studio's latest public pass focused on smoke-run reliability
items.summary: The recent manager-side pass caught and fixed a release-smoke issue while keeping the studio workflow moving forward.

items.title: Canvas Planner stayed clean and review-ready in its latest public pass
items.summary: The latest public-ready manager pass kept the board surface fast and uncluttered while tightening browser behavior.

items.title: Playwright MCP 0.0.70 landed as the latest maintenance release
items.summary: The current tagged release is a maintenance cut, while the docs continue to push Playwright MCP as a first-class browser layer for agent workflows.

items.title: n8n kept its March 2026 release line moving
items.summary: The March release notes show continued 1.12x shipping, while docs and blog updates highlight secrets-provider and workflow-hardening work.

items.title: OpenAI launched GPT-5.4
items.summary: GPT-5.4 arrived with native computer use, tool search, and 1M-token context, reinforcing OpenAI's focus on real agent workflows.

items.title: Perplexity doubled down on its product thesis in March 2026
items.summary: Perplexity's public blog framed 'The AI is the Computer' and kept tying that story to its API and device ambitions from late February.

items.title: Anthropic's current system-card set centers Claude Sonnet 4.6
items.summary: Anthropic's model materials list Claude Sonnet 4.6 as the current Sonnet generation and explicitly note API access among the active surfaces.

items.title: Wrangler 4.58.0 improved command grouping and auth ergonomics
items.summary: Cloudflare's Workers SDK release added grouped help categories, better auth token retrieval, and type generation on dev startup.
